unequal_q4_rewrite.prior_inferred_note: All 24 Q4 QKV singleton calls plus half of the 48 same-shape gate singleton calls; gate attribution assumes the paired half equals the family mean.

comparison_to_post_q5_profile.interpretation: The intended Q4/Q4 window drops by 10.924 ms while launch count stays fixed, validating shared common-prefix activation traversal rather than launch contraction. Total kernel sum improves by 7.952 ms; unrelated large families move by at most 1.71%, consistent with ordinary profiler clock drift. Authoritative retained throughput remains the counterbalanced full-engine A/B evidence in the unequal-Q4 retained artifact.

remaining_exact_q4_role_census.method: The exact Q4 singleton grid X identifies output width because the kernel uses 48 output columns per block and WG128. Both roles retain two 256-row Y blocks at M512.
remaining_exact_q4_role_census.inventory_note: The 24 Q4/Q4 linear pairs have left the singleton family. The remaining 24 gate calls belong to Q6-QKV/Q4-gate layers, and the remaining 16 wide calls are full-attention Q. Existing evidence closes both singleton source-F16 lanes: W7900 M512 gate confirmation is negative and full-Q loses at M4096.

next_lane.reason: The retained changed-arithmetic chain is now the only operation boundary with enough aggregate residual and a genuinely new byte-neutral mechanism. Its cast + Q4/Q5/Q6 producer + rocBLAS + output-cast family totals 176.001 ms / 32.59% of M512 kernel sum. Planar-Q6 producers alone are 22.963 ms / 4.25%, the largest format-specific producer family, across 288 launches. The current planar producer reconstructs each F16 value from the 12-byte qmicro record but still performs scalar per-element record addressing; a direct tile producer can stage one sole-resident qmicro record/metadata slab and emit vectorized contiguous F16 for the unchanged qualified rocBLAS consumer without adding a payload, workspace, or arithmetic change.
next_lane.first_gate: Implement a temporary direct planar-Q6T16-to-F16 producer for the current bounded tile ABI and compare producer-inclusive dequantize + rocBLAS + output-cast wall against the retained producer on actual Q6 FFN-down, linear-QKV, and full-attention-V weights at M512/1024/4096 on XTX and W7900. Require exact F16 producer bytes and unchanged final BF16 output. Stop at the leaf if every required row does not win; only then replace the registered producer and run full-engine safeguards.
next_lane.ceiling_note: The 22.963-ms producer family is the immediate isolated ceiling; the 176.001-ms complete chain is an operation-boundary census, not a projected saving.
excluded_by_fresh_profile: Do not reopen blind Q4 FFN geometry, accumulator serialization, launch-bound, epilogue, metadata-transport, or K-stage sweeps; the retained local128 kernel remains the measured local optimum after the complete mechanism ladder.
Do not reopen remaining exact-Q4 singleton source-F16 routes: the unpaired gate failed W7900 M512 and full-attention Q failed M4096.
Do not tune GDN for prefill parity: the pipeline is 7.73% of kernel sum and prior matched module evidence has the recurrent core ahead of its comparator.
Attention, dense F32, casts alone, fills, copies, and launch-count-only work each lack sufficient fresh ceiling.

decision: Retain the unequal-Q4 default unchanged, publish the measured sub-window validation, close remaining exact-Q4 and GDN retries, and screen a direct planar-Q6T16 F16 tile producer next. This profiler artifact changes no production path and makes no new throughput claim.
